notes.title: Hexadrift - Mac Support
notes.content:
Due to compatibility issues with the Mac Catalina OS, Hexadrift will no longer be available to download for the Mac operating system. 

Players that have downloaded the game and have NOT updated to Catalina will still be able to play.

Apologies for any inconvenience this may cause.

Thank you,
Henagames

notes.title: Hexadrift 1.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hexadrift 1.0.3 is released and available for updating!

Changes for Hexadrift 1.0.3 (01/05/21)
[b]
Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Hexadrift no longer requires a constant internet connection. Still requires being launched from the Steam client
[*] This update is [b]NOT[/b] backwards compatible! If you have an in-progress game, you will be restarted when you update to this version. See note below.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made refueling the Scanner at the Starbase cheaper to help with early-game “catch-22” situations
[*] Made Fuel auto-refill much faster[list]
[*] Previous: 1 Fuel every 15 seconds
[*] Updated: 5 Fuel every 5 seconds[/list]
[*] Increased Resource Sell Ratio[list]
[*] Previous: 100 Resources for 350 Currency
[*] Updated: 100 Resources for 500 Currency[/list]
[*] Numerous other bug fixes and tweaks
[/list]

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added volume controls for Music and SFX/UI instead of Mute/Unmute toggles
[*] Decreased number of particles expelled when scanning a resource-hex
[/list]

[b]Important note on migrating to offline data storage:[/b]
Previous versions of Hexadrift employed an online back-end service to remotely set game-data and store user data (saved games) in the cloud for cross-machine play, anti-cheating mechanisms and other things. This back-end service is typically very stable, however there are times when connections are refused, or the service is very slow causing issues in-game.

This 1.0.3 update moves everything away from the back-end service and stores all game related data locally for complete offline play. Since the back-end service has been [b]REMOVED [/b]from the game entirely, you will no longer be able to load up your save game from previous versions. 

[b]If you are in the middle of a game playing on version 1.0.2 or below, you will be restarted when you update to 1.0.3. If you have already completed the game, you will keep all of your achievements, but you will be restarted from the beginning of the game like any other new player.[/b]

I hope this update makes Hexadrift more stable and that you can enjoy the game uninterrupted!

notes.title: Hexadrift - v1.0.1 Release Notes
notes.content:
Hexadrift v1.0.1 is released and available for update.

Changes for Hexadrift v1.0.1 - (11/25/19)

[b]UI Updates[/b]
[list][*] General UI improvements
[*] Updated Sector Map UI to include how many Credits are being collected
[*] Updated Resource Award Ceremony to be one-click instead of many
[*] Made Extraction button bigger and much more obvious
[*] Added visible scrollbars on Upgrades, Sectors, Parts and Ship screens
[*] Added and removed some of the Loading Tips
[*] New Refuel options[/list]

[b]Tutorials and Alerts Updates[/b]
[list][*] Added “out-of-fuel” tutorial. When you hit 36 (or less) fuel for the first time, it shows the refuel and exit options tutorial message
[*] Added tutorial counter on Sector tutorials so players know how long it is
[*] Added a “Low On Fuel” reminder if you try to enter a sector with less than 144 units (half-tank) of fuel
[*] Added new tutorial view for players that are visiting the Refueling station in the Starbase that can’t afford to refuel
[*] Added ability to re-read all of the Tutorial messages from the Options menu[/list]

[b]Functional Updates[/b][list]
[*] Lowered the amount of damage taken from enemies when no upgrades are applied from 40 to 30
[*] Optimizations to when Enemy steals Fuel (if no resources in hold).
[*] Game initialization optimizations, more error reporting and a fix for the 'infinite loading screen' for new players
[*] Fixed camera jump when entering a Sector
[*] Added a third option for cheaper refueling. If you are really really broke, have no resources to sell, and completely out of fuel, the only option is to wait for the auto generation. Now you can get a "small" tank of fuel to get the credits you need or resources to sell[/list]

Special thanks to all those that have played and given me some incredible feedback! I'm always open to hearing any feedback, bugs, comments or suggestions, so keep it coming!

I hope you all continue to enjoy Hexadrift, and THANK YOU for playing!

Tim @ Henagames

notes.title: Hexadrift is Live!
notes.content:
[b]Hexadrift has launched! [/b]

I am excited to announce that Hexadrift has officially launched for PC and Mac!

Hexadrift is a new casual game from Henagames, a one-man indie dev studio based in Southern California.

---

[b]Game Description[/b]
You and your crew have been sent to the Urnian Galaxy for a routine fly-by. During the mission, an unknown anomaly severely damaged your ship and crashed on the Urnian Starbase TH-1977. You are the sole survivor, except for your trusty HARV9 on-board computer, stranded in the middle of nowhere.

Luckily, the Starbase has functional Sector Scanners that can be used to scan the nearby sectors for all of the resources you'll need to fully repair the Euclidean.

Explore and plunder 11 unique sectors, collect 9 different resource types, strategize and plan the most optimal paths and keep an eye on your fuel usage!

Hexadrift is a casual game of resource collection and repair. Gather the resources, credits and fuel you need to fully repair the ship and get back to the comforts of deep space!

----

I am really excited for this announcement and I can't wait for you all to play Hexadrift! Being my first Steam game, it's pretty nerve-wracking, but I believe in this game and I think all you casual gamers out there will enjoy your time with HARV9 working your way out of the Urnian Galaxy!

Happy gaming everyone!

Tim @ Henagames
